source.authors: Lam Hui and Nickolay Y. Gnedin
source.title: Equation of State of the Photoionized Intergalactic Medium

CE.underlying_reference: HG97 compilation of Black (1981), corrected by Cen (1992)

application.abundance_definition: Y_i is nuclei or ions of native species i per baryon
application.isotope_extension: One electronic coefficient for H1/D/T and one for He3/He4 at the same charge; isotope shifts are not added.
application.CI_energy_increment: Use atomic.ionization_energy_J[upper] - atomic.ionization_energy_J[lower], not k_B times the HG97 rate threshold.
application.CI_energy_scope: Kinetic energy is transferred to canonical ionization binding energy. CI itself has zero photon escape.
application.threshold_hybrid: HG97 thresholds control rate shapes; the parent's energy ladder controls energy accounting. Their mismatch is reported per channel.
application.CE_energy_scope: Positive optically thin line-cooling/escape power for the two included electronic channels.
application.extrapolation: Explicitly requested analytic continuation is diagnostic and has no published accuracy claim outside the stated intervals.
